data.reason_zh: 提出TORSI：教师依据失败和验证分数迭代写入可复用指令，两轮提升并迁移至其他模型，属方法型RSI。

scope_support.feedback_quote: validation scores determine which updates are adopted.
scope_support.object_quote: a slow teacher studies failures and tests corrections in paused games between attempts, then writes reusable instructions for a fast student.
scope_support.persistence_quote: The instructions also improve average scores for three other models without retuning.
